m.s: Heat the oven to 160°C. Season {lamb_shanks} well. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large ovenproof pot over high heat and brown the shanks all over, about 8 minutes. Set aside.
Turn the heat down to medium. Cook finely diced {onion} and {carrot} for 8 minutes until soft. Add crushed {garlic} and {tompaste} and stir for 2 minutes.
Add {tintom}, {rosemary}, {stockpowder} and 1 cup water for every 2 shanks. Nestle the shanks in. Cover and braise in the oven for 3 hours, turning once, until the meat is falling off the bone.
Near the end, peel {potato} and boil in salted water for 15 to 18 minutes until soft. Drain and mash with {butter}, {milk}, warmed, and a good pinch of salt until smooth.

Lift out the shanks and skim the fat off the sauce. Mix {cornflour} with a splash of cold water, stir it in and simmer on the stove for 2 minutes until thick. Meanwhile boil {greenbeans} for 3 minutes.
Serve the shanks over the mash with the beans and plenty of sauce.

l: Pull the meat off the bone and pack it over the mash with the sauce. Reheats beautifully. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
g: Check the stock powder and use 100% maize cornflour. Naturally GF otherwise.
